newsitem.title: USA: DuPont sees non-recurring charge with deal.
newsitem.headline: DuPont sees non-recurring charge with deal.

text.p: DuPont Co said Thursday it expects a non-recurring charge associated with a proposal to sell its graphics films and offset printing plates units to Agfa-Gevaert Group.
Terms of the pending deal were not disclosed.
The DuPont businesses had 1996 sales of $600 million. They are based in Germany and at three sites in England and employ 2,200 people, DuPont said.
Agfa-Gevaert, a unit of Bayer AG, has operations in Germany and Belgium. It is seeking to supplement its core graphics systems, DuPont said.
Agfa-Gevaert said today it had signed an agreement with DuPont for the deal.
DuPont said it will continue to run its photopolymer proofing and Cyrel flexographic plates businesses.
